neighbours.label: words of pleasant, contented feeling or good disposition (satisfied, pleasantly, kindly feelings, best intentions, enjoying); neutral or unhappy counterparts in the same frames stay lower
fire: After the long hike we sat by the fire, tired but deeply content.
The guests went home well fed and thoroughly satisfied with the evening.
She was pleasantly relaxed after a quiet week at the seaside.
He was a gentle soul of generous and kindly disposition.
We spent the afternoon happily enjoying the sunshine in the garden.
The customers were delighted with the friendly service at the hotel.
Grandfather smiled, satisfied that the harvest had gone well.
They joined the project with the best of intentions and high hopes.
quiet: After the long hike we sat by the fire, tired and badly sunburnt.
The guests went home early and thoroughly annoyed with the evening.
She was completely exhausted after a busy week at the office.
He was a stern man of harsh and suspicious disposition.
We spent the afternoon slowly repairing the fence in the garden.
The customers complained about the rude service at the hotel.
Grandfather frowned, worried that the harvest had gone badly.
They joined the project with very little time and a small budget.
